title: docs-kit site.yaml
description: Content contract for a consuming project's docs/site.yaml: everything the docs site needs that is not a docs page.

name.description: Project name as shown in the site title and landing hero. Usually the binary or repository name.

tagline.description: One sentence under the name on the landing hero and in the site meta description: what the project is and for whom.

theme.description: Design theme, one of the CSS token files shipped in packages/starlight-kit/themes/<name>.css. Changes look only, never layout.

repo.description: Repository URL, used for the GitHub link and 'edit this page' links.

install.description: Install methods in order of preference. The first one is shown on the landing hero with a copy button; all are listed below it.

code.description: Shell command that installs or runs the project, copied verbatim.

features.description: Landing page feature grid: 3 to 6 short selling points, each grounded in what the code actually does.

links.description: Extra links shown on the landing page, e.g. docs.rs, pkg.go.dev, changelog. Library API docs are linked, never copied.

reference.description: How refgen produces the generated pages under reference/. Omit when the project has no CLI.

cli.description: CLI reference generated by walking '<bin> --help' and every subcommand.

bin.description: Command name as users type it; used for page titles and file names.

build.description: Shell command, run from the repository root, that builds the binary, e.g. 'cargo build --release', 'go build -o bin/x .' or 'nix build'. Requires 'path'.

path.description: Path to the built binary relative to the repository root, e.g. 'target/release/kasha' or 'result/bin/kasha'. When omitted, 'bin' is looked up on PATH.
